verdict.why: The visible overlap is the Redis service-logger success/failure hook calls, timing, and log_redis_failure then re-raise. That is logging boilerplate, which the task says can stay at call sites. It is also repeated across many methods and is not specific to these two. The functions do different work. NEW is a single-key LPOP with an optional count, a Redis-version branch, namespace fixing, and bytes-to-str decoding. EXISTING is a bulk pipeline LPOP that delegates to `_pipeline_lpop_helper`. The decoding in EXISTING is hidden inside that helper, so the source does not show an independently repeated decode operation. Any shared logic for older-Redis count handling would sit in `handle_lpop_count_for_older_redis_versions` or the helper, which are already separate owners.
